title: Project overview
description: A little clarity for work in progress.
guidance: Combine status, progress, and people in a compact project summary. The details action is local to this example.

title: Profile & connect
description: A considered introduction to your people.
guidance: Use an avatar, a short description, and one clear action to introduce a person. Follow is a local preview state.

title: Team invite
description: Make room for the people you work with.
guidance: Pair a clearly labelled email field with a direct action. This example validates locally and does not send email.

title: Storage overview
description: Make usage feel easy to understand.
guidance: Show an accessible progress value together with the amount used. The breakdown is demo data.

title: Notification preferences
description: Give people control over the noise.
guidance: Use clearly labelled switches for immediate preferences. These controls are local to the preview.

title: Pricing plan
description: A more thoughtful way to choose a plan.
guidance: Show the price and billing period clearly. The billing toggle and selection are demonstration states only.

title: Activity feed
description: The important little updates, in one place.
guidance: Use clear names, actions, and timestamps to help people scan recent activity. Marking items read is local to this preview.

title: Feedback survey
description: A simple moment to listen and learn.
guidance: Label each rating and provide a clear selected state. This example stores a local selection only.

title: Release highlight
description: A warmer welcome to what's new.
guidance: Use a concise headline and a clear next action. This example expands locally to show more detail.

title: Button
description: Trigger actions with clear visual hierarchy.
guidance: Use a primary button for the main action, and secondary or ghost buttons for supporting actions.

title: Card
description: Group related content in a contained surface.
guidance: Use the header, content, and footer parts to structure related information.

title: Switch
description: Turn a setting on or off immediately.
guidance: Give every switch a clear label. Use it for settings that take effect immediately.

title: Input
description: Collect a single line of text.
guidance: Pair Input with Field to associate its label, description, and validation message.

title: Dialog
description: Focus attention on a task or message.
guidance: Include a title and description. The dialog manages focus and supports Escape to close.

title: Badge
description: Give a status or label a little emphasis.
guidance: Keep labels short and make sure status is understandable without relying on color alone.

title: Tabs
description: Organize related content into views.
guidance: Label the tab list and provide a panel for each tab. Use arrow keys to move between tabs.

title: Accordion
description: Reveal information progressively.
guidance: Use concise headings so people can scan and expand the content they need.

title: Checkbox
description: Select one or more independent options.
guidance: Use checkboxes for independent choices and give each one a descriptive label.

title: Select
description: Choose an option from a compact list.
guidance: Provide an accessible name for the trigger and descriptive labels for each option.

title: Alert
description: Communicate important inline messages.
guidance: Choose a variant that matches the message and explain what happened in text.

title: Avatar
description: Represent a person with an image or initials.
guidance: Provide meaningful alternative text for images and a fallback for missing images.

title: Progress
description: Show the progress of a task.
guidance: Use a descriptive label and a value from 0 to 100 for determinate progress.

title: Slider
description: Choose a value within a range.
guidance: Give the slider a label and useful minimum and maximum values. Arrow keys adjust the value.

title: Radio group
description: Choose one option from a visible set.
guidance: Label the group and describe each option so the choice is easy to understand.

title: Textarea
description: Make room for longer responses.
guidance: Always associate the textarea with a visible label.

title: Tooltip
description: Add a useful hint on hover or focus.
guidance: Keep hints brief and avoid placing essential information only in a tooltip.

title: Pagination
description: Move through a set of pages.
guidance: Pagination is controlled: keep the current page in state and update it with onPageChange.

title: Skeleton
description: Indicate that content is loading.
guidance: Use placeholders that resemble the content being loaded and provide an accessible loading label.

title: Spinner
description: Indicate an ongoing operation.
guidance: Provide a meaningful label so the loading state is communicated to assistive technology.

title: Empty state
description: Make an empty view feel like a beginning.
guidance: Explain why the view is empty and offer a useful next action when appropriate.

title: Popover
description: Show contextual content near a trigger.
guidance: Use a clear trigger and keep contextual content focused and concise.

title: Dropdown menu
description: Offer a compact list of actions.
guidance: Group related actions, label the trigger, and use separators sparingly.

title: Collapsible
description: Show or hide supplementary content.
guidance: Use a descriptive trigger that makes the hidden content easy to understand.

title: Combobox
description: Search and select from a list.
guidance: Use a visible label and provide an empty state when no results match.

title: Toggle
description: Turn a pressed state on or off.
guidance: Use a descriptive accessible label for icon-only toggles.

title: Table
description: Present structured information in rows.
guidance: Use table headers and a caption to give data context.

title: Alert dialog
description: Ask for confirmation before an action.
guidance: Use for consequential decisions and provide a clear way to cancel.

title: Sheet
description: Open a panel from the edge of the screen.
guidance: Give the sheet a title and description, and provide a way to close it.

title: Keyboard shortcut
description: Display a keyboard shortcut.
guidance: Combine key labels with text that explains the action.

title: Aspect ratio
description: Keep media at a consistent proportion.
guidance: Set the ratio to match the media you want to display.

title: Separator
description: Separate groups of related content.
guidance: Use sparingly to add structure without adding visual noise.

title: Link
description: Connect people to another destination.
guidance: Use descriptive link text so the destination is clear.

title: Breadcrumb
description: Show where you are in a hierarchy.
guidance: Use a labelled navigation trail and mark the current page clearly.

title: Toast
description: Offer a brief, non-blocking update.
guidance: Use toasts for brief status messages, not important information that needs a permanent home.
